user_motivation: Existing provenance-based intrusion detection systems are often real-time in log collection, but not real-time in alert semantics. They typically require graph construction, window completion, batching, pruning, segmentation, or periodic inference before an alert can be raised. CS4M targets a stricter deployment model: every provenance event is scored as it arrives, before the event updates detector state, and the system emits immediately explainable alert evidence without materializing a full provenance graph.
